source.projection: Cargo manifests, Cargo.lock, rust-toolchain.toml, and Rust source files

contract.stream: one caller-owned non-default stream per command queue
contract.bindings: checked read and read-write leases remain borrowed until completion
contract.completion: one preallocated CUDA event is recorded once per non-empty scope
contract.ordering: same-stream FIFO with no intermediate host wait

rejection_cases.stage: second launch after one successful launch

failure_policy.driver_launch_error: retain resources, poison the scope, and confirm CUDA quiescence
failure_policy.completion_error: fall back from event to stream and context synchronization

commands: cargo oxide run rms_norm_f32_h20 --bin rms_norm_f32_h20 --features cuda --arch sm_90
accepted_claims: the permanent F32 provider matches the CPU reference on four declared shapes
two RMSNorm launches chain on one non-default stream without an intermediate host wait
one completion event covers both launches in each chained scope
the same command queue and checked bindings run two consecutive scopes
a contract error after one successful launch exercises guarded scope cleanup
the generated PTX targets sm_90 and assembles with ptxas
excluded_claims: fault-injected CUDA driver, event, stream, or context failure behavior
allocation-free enqueue because the generated launcher creates an argument vector
debug-profile device tests because the pinned compiler fails DisjointSlice MIR verification
Compute Sanitizer coverage because the tool is unavailable on this host
